sents.zh: 金朝的时候，北方住着很多不同的人。
sents.en: In the Jin dynasty many different peoples lived in the north.

sents.zh: 他们说的话不一样，写的字也不一样。
sents.en: They spoke differently and wrote differently.

sents.zh: 因为要一起做事，所以很多年轻人开始学汉字。
sents.en: Because they had to work together, many young people began learning Chinese characters.

sents.zh: 他们每天很早就去学校。
sents.en: They went to school very early each day.

sents.zh: 老师先教他们读，然后才教写。
sents.en: The teacher taught them to read first, and only then to write.

sents.zh: 一个字要写很多很多次。
sents.en: One character had to be written many times over.

sents.zh: 如果写得不好，就再写一次。
sents.en: If it was not good, they wrote it again.
Some were still reading in the evening.

sents.zh: 因为家里没有很多光，所以他们坐到门口去看。
sents.en: Because there was little light at home, they sat by the door to read.

sents.zh: 学好了以后，他们可以做很多事情。
sents.en: Once they had learned, they could do many things.

sents.zh: 有的人做官，有的人做买卖。
他们也没有忘记自己的字。
sents.en: They did not forget their own writing either.

sents.zh: 他们把两边的书放在一起看。
sents.en: They read the books of both sides together.

sents.zh: 他们说：“读书的人，走到哪里都可以。”
sents.en: They said: "A person who has studied can get on anywhere."
